events.title: McDonald's to Post Q1 Earnings: What's in the Cards for the Stock?
events.body: MCD is set to report Q1 2026 on May 7, with value, menu and digital momentum supporting results, while weather impacts and cost pressures weigh.

events.title: Dutch Bros to Post Q1 Earnings: What's in the Cards for the Stock?
events.body: BROS is set to report Q1 2026 on May 6, with EPS and revenues seen rising on same-shop gains and new shops, while higher coffee costs weigh.
